verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json: it returns HTTP 200 and contains the "openapi" key, so the product directly provides a machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and how to obtain it, confirmation that it covers the Workers API endpoints and how complete it is, and independent corroboration beyond the single probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
